title: Angled shafts with one tooth contact
description: rotation from the assigned viewing end
question: Drive A CW. Determine the motion of B (spin) at the shown instant. Use the labeled contact views.

answer.explanation: Drive A CW. At the tooth section the two rim tangents must coincide. The marked CW tangents oppose one another. A positive, B negative. The requested motion is CCW (in listed output order).

options.label: A
options.explanation: B must be CCW. At the tooth section the two rim tangents must coincide. The marked CW tangents oppose one another. A positive, B negative..

options.label: B
options.explanation: B must be CCW. At the tooth section the two rim tangents must coincide. The marked CW tangents oppose one another. A positive, B negative..

options.label: C
options.explanation: All requested motions agree with the contact constraints.

options.label: D
options.explanation: B must be CCW. At the tooth section the two rim tangents must coincide. The marked CW tangents oppose one another. A positive, B negative..
